title: Autofill field name is "webauthn" when autocomplete ends in "webauthn"
body:
In the [autofill processing model](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-control-infrastructure.html#autofill-processing-model), *field* is set to the last token and never updated. When that token is "webauthn", the substeps step back one token to reset *category* and to prepend that token to *IDL value*, but *field* stays "webauthn". So for `autocomplete="email webauthn"` the IDL-exposed autofill value is "email webauthn", but the autofill field name, which tells the user agent what kind of data the control expects, is "webauthn" rather than "email".

This goes back to #8006, which added "webauthn"; #8232 fixed the IDL value and category for this path, but not *field*. Implementations that follow the spec's steps copied the bug, e.g., [WebKit](https://github.com/WebKit/WebKit/blob/13a1f2916933547024ee020d94031096a41eb7cb/Source/WebCore/html/Autofill.cpp#L211) and [Ladybird](https://github.com/LadybirdBrowser/ladybird/blob/9483430f275ee8072230c3f2cfbfba87156d3295/Libraries/LibWeb/HTML/AutocompleteElement.cpp#L314). On iOS, WebKit then [maps the "webauthn" field name to `UITextContentTypeUsername`](https://github.com/WebKit/WebKit/blob/13a1f2916933547024ee020d94031096a41eb7cb/Source/WebKit/UIProcess/ios/WKContentViewInteraction.mm#L7288), so `email webauthn` gets the username text content type rather than the email address one.

Proposed fix: in the "webauthn" substeps, after decrementing *index*, set *field* to the *index*th token in *tokens* and use it for *category* and *IDL value*. A lone "webauthn" keeps "webauthn" as its autofill field name.

#8232 also changed *field* from "the string given in the cell of the first column of the matching row", i.e., the lowercase token from the table, to "the *index*th token in *tokens*", which keeps the author's casing. Per the spec, `autocomplete="NAME"` therefore has an IDL-exposed autofill value of "NAME", whereas [form-autocomplete.html](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/7508e55e0790c019e1188576c2f4fbb5cea90ccc/html/semantics/forms/the-form-element/form-autocomplete.html#L57) expects "name". The token prepended in the "webauthn" substeps has the same problem. We can fix this at the same time by converting *field* to ASCII lowercase in both places.
